video.acting_natural.evidence: [Riley·claude] With the sound off, this reads as a vlogger who has just crossed the street. She turns to the camera and explains, with gestures, that the wet street behind her is crossed using the stepping stones. That matches the point of the shot. Going second by second as Riley: 0–1.0s, the shot starts low on my chest while I'm still moving and my left hand hangs by my side. 1.25–1.75s, the camera swings up to my face and I'm smiling with my mouth open, a little out of breath. That fits having just hopped onto the sidewalk and turned around. 2.0–7.5s, I talk to the camera with small natural head and expression changes and look into the lens the whole time. The single-eye closings at 4.0s and 6.0–6.25s read as blinks or squints mid-speech, not as staring stiffly. 7.75–9.75s, my left palm opens out toward the street behind me for the 'drain' gesture. The hand stays out through the half-beat pause, which is natural carry-over. 10.25–12.0s, it turns into a thumb point back toward the stepping stones while my eyes stay on the camera. 12.25s, the hand drops right away, so the gesture isn't dragged out or repeated. 14.0–14.75s, for 'whatever's in there' I wrinkle my nose and squint, a mild disgust face lasting about one second. That is no bigger than the joke and isn't held. 15.0–15.75s, it goes back to normal speech. 16.0–17.75s, I smile and nod at the camera with my mouth closed. Reactions are on time, each gesture is used once, and I never look stiff or posed.

video.point_landed.evidence: [director·codex] 关声音看到的是女子在古街自拍讲解，先摊手示意身后，再用拇指指向垫脚石（图1约7.75–12.25秒）。能看懂她在介绍街道和石头，但街面的湿润反光没有清楚建立排水及绕石流动的关系，画面未讲清看点中的‘街就是排水沟，所以用垫脚石避开污水’。
